newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Main index drops on Vilnius bourse.
newsitem.headline: Main index drops on Vilnius bourse.

text.p: The main index for Lithuania's bourse fell on Tuesday amid a relatively slow day of trading, brokers said.
Turnover on the central market was 341,000 litas and the group A index, which tracks the 22 most active companies on the bourse, fell 5.65 percent to 1,626.65.
Group G, which measures less active firms, rose by 0.25 percent to 1,306.
Birzai milk, the country's second largest dairy producer, was the most active central market listing at 151,000 litas and the share price rose by 7.14 percent to 4.50 litas.
Nomura Securities and Vilniaus Bank announced on Tuesday that they would undertake a $6.0 million international equity offering on behalf of Birzai.
"Overall, prices should rise in the long run on the central market, as supply still exceeds demand," one dealer told Reuters.
There was one bloc trade on Tuesday worth 238,000 litas involving shares in the state-run Lithuania Gas company.
The index for the secondary T-bill market edged up 0.03 percent to 1,207.5 and only 15,000 litas worth of three-month T-bills traded hands at a yield of 10.22 percent.
